Yes, when filling out official forms that require your Social Security Number (SSN), your name should match exactly how it appears on your Social Security card. 

Mismatches between the name on the form and the name associated with your SSN in government databases can lead to processing delays, rejections, or issues with tax reporting, background checks, and employment verification.

If you can provide the expiry date of your passport and the country you are applying to visit, I can give you a much more specific answer!

Mismatches between the name on your documents and the name you provide on forms (such as flight tickets, visa applications, employment verification, or background checks) can lead to processing delays, rejections, or issues with identity verification.
